verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-infrastructure SaaS platform, so choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions regions, residency, or data location controls. Choosing among multiple bank partners and holding SOC 2 / PCI DSS certifications are adjacent features, not residency selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
